subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should destructive `claws remove` remain in this slice only after authoritative inventory, complete canonical deletion planning, serialized package cleanup, and removal tombstones are implemented, or should removal be split out until those contracts are designed?
rationale: The remaining questions define permanent ownership, consent, recovery, concurrency, and audit semantics across agents, sessions, plugins, skills, and shared state; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: Complete the lifecycle contract
options.body: Keep status and remove together, but require the full authoritative inventory, consent, serialization, cleanup, and tombstone design before merge.

options.title: Land status without removal
options.body: Narrow this slice to read-only authoritative status and defer destructive removal to a separately reviewed lifecycle PR.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Hold this PR and dependent slices until the RFC establishes the complete Crew/Claw host lifecycle and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Complete the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Keep status and remove together, but require the full authoritative inventory, consent, serialization, cleanup, and tombstone design before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent shared-state architecture work makes them the strongest available owner for the cross-cutting persistence, transaction, and lifecycle decision.
